Add applyPatch for JSON Patch (RFC 6902)

Implements the six operations add, remove, replace, move, copy and test
in applyPatch(document, patch). The input document and the patch are not
mutated; values taken from the patch are copied into the result. An
invalid patch throws a SyntaxError, and a failing operation throws an
Error without returning a partial result.

Pointer parsing is factored out of resolvePointer so both share it.
